overview.about: Primavera Sound is Barcelona's celebrated music festival, known for one of the most eclectic and critically adored line-ups anywhere - mixing indie, pop, hip-hop and electronic across generations. Held at the seafront Parc del Forum, it has a devoted international following.
overview.nextEvent: The next Primavera Sound is held at the Parc del Forum on Barcelona's waterfront. Its famously broad, tastemaking line-up runs across many stages late into the night, drawing a large international crowd.
